description: Configure or remove a blog's custom domain. Use domain only for custom domains (requires CNAME/A DNS). Use domain + domain_slug for subdirectory hosting (requires TXT DNS verification). Pass an empty domain string to remove the domain.

domain.description: Custom domain (e.g. blog.example.com) or root domain for subdirectory mode. Pass empty string to remove.

domain_slug.description: Optional subdirectory slug for subdirectory hosting (e.g. example.com + blog).

name: update_blog_domain
title: Update blog domain
